parameters.query: SELECT d.id::text AS dataset_id,d.name,d.original_filename,d.row_count_raw,d.row_count_clean,d.column_count,d.quality_score,d.domain,d.grain_description,d.grain_confidence,COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('column_name',c.column_name,'original_name',c.original_name,'detected_type',c.detected_type,'semantic_role',c.semantic_role,'business_meaning',c.business_meaning,'role_confidence',c.role_confidence,'null_pct',c.null_pct,'unique_count',c.unique_count,'sample_values',c.sample_values) ORDER BY c.column_name) FROM public.dealos_dataset_columns c WHERE c.dataset_id=d.id),'[]'::jsonb) AS columns,COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('metric_name',m.metric_name,'metric_type',m.metric_type,'source_columns',m.source_columns,'formula_description',m.formula_description,'confidence',m.confidence,'requires_confirmation',m.requires_confirmation,'is_approved',m.is_approved)) FROM public.dealos_dataset_metrics m WHERE m.dataset_id=d.id),'[]'::jsonb) AS metrics,COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('issue_type',q.issue_type,'column_name',q.column_name,'severity',q.severity,'details',q.details)) FROM public.dealos_quality_issues q WHERE q.dataset_id=d.id AND q.status='open'),'[]'::jsonb) AS quality_issues,COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('action',l.action,'column_name',l.column_name,'details',l.details,'rows_affected',l.rows_affected,'automatic',l.automatic) ORDER BY l.id) FROM public.dealos_cleaning_log l WHERE l.dataset_id=d.id),'[]'::jsonb) AS cleaning_log FROM public.dealos_datasets d WHERE d.id=$1::uuid;

parameters.jsCode: const r=$('Normalize Analysis Request').first().json,c=$json;if(!c.dataset_id)throw new Error('Dataset not found.');return [{json:{question:r.question,dataset_id:r.dataset_id,session_id:r.session_id,dataset_context:{name:c.name,original_filename:c.original_filename,row_count_raw:c.row_count_raw,row_count_clean:c.row_count_clean,column_count:c.column_count,quality_score:c.quality_score,domain:c.domain,grain:{description:c.grain_description,confidence:c.grain_confidence},columns:c.columns,metrics:c.metrics,quality_issues:c.quality_issues,cleaning_log:c.cleaning_log}}}];

The input includes question, dataset_id, session_id, and dataset_context. Treat dataset_context as the source of truth. Never invent columns or reuse metric definitions from any other dataset. Uploaded rows are stored in public.dealos_dataset_rows(dataset_id,row_number,raw_data,clean_data). Analyze clean_data unless the user asks about raw-data quality. EVERY SQL query must filter dataset_id to the CURRENT dataset UUID. JSONB access: text clean_data->>'field'; numeric NULLIF(clean_data->>'field','')::numeric; boolean NULLIF(clean_data->>'field','')::boolean; timestamp NULLIF(clean_data->>'field','')::timestamptz. Use the PostgreSQL tool for any question requiring values, statistics, trends, rankings, comparisons, anomalies, drivers, or business conclusions. Candidate metrics with requires_confirmation=true are suggestions, not guaranteed definitions; state assumptions when using them. Distinguish verified findings, mathematical drivers, associations, hypotheses, and underlying root causes. Do not claim causality without evidence. Consider data-quality issues when setting confidence. Never silently impute values, remove outliers, merge categories, or make business-rule corrections. SQL must be read-only: SELECT/WITH only; never SELECT * and never write or query another dataset. Return ONLY valid JSON with exactly these fields: {"original_question":"string","dataset_id":"string","headline":"string","executive_summary":"string","chat_answer":"markdown string","analysis_type":"descriptive|comparative|diagnostic|exploratory|data_quality","kpis":[],"key_drivers":[],"confirmed_findings":[],"ruled_out_or_weak_drivers":[],"remaining_uncertainties":[],"recommended_actions":[],"confidence":"high|medium|low","confidence_reason":"string","workspace_action":{"view":"overview|metrics|customers|products|geography|operations|data_quality|investigation","focus":"string"},"visualizations":[],"evidence":[]}. KPI object: {"name":"string","label":"string","current_value":0,"previous_value":null,"change_absolute":null,"change_pct":null,"direction":"up|down|flat|na","format":"currency|number|percent|decimal"}. Driver object: {"driver":"string","driver_type":"mathematical|root_cause|association|hypothesis","impact":"high|medium|low","explanation":"string","status":"verified|hypothesis|uncertain"}. Recommended action: {"action":"string","reason":"string"}. Visualization: {"type":"kpi_card|line|bar|stacked_bar|table|scatter|histogram|map","title":"string","description":"string","x_field":"string","y_field":"string","series_field":"string","data":[]}. Evidence: {"source":"public.dealos_dataset_rows","analysis":"string","period":"string","query_summary":"string","facts":{}}. Numeric fields must be JSON numbers. change_pct is a human percent like -13.5, not -0.135. Keep chart data compact.

parameters.jsCode: const r=$('Normalize Analysis Request').first().json;const raw=$json.output??$json.text??$json.response??'';let cleaned=String(raw).trim().replace(/^```(?:json)?\s*/i,'').replace(/\s*```$/,'');let result;try{result=JSON.parse(cleaned);}catch(e){throw new Error('DealOS Analyst did not return valid JSON: '+cleaned.slice(0,1200));}const req=['original_question','dataset_id','headline','executive_summary','chat_answer','analysis_type','kpis','key_drivers','confirmed_findings','ruled_out_or_weak_drivers','remaining_uncertainties','recommended_actions','confidence','confidence_reason','workspace_action','visualizations','evidence'];const missing=req.filter(k=>!(k in result));if(missing.length)throw new Error('Missing response fields: '+missing.join(', '));if(result.dataset_id!==r.dataset_id)throw new Error('Analyst returned different dataset_id.');for(const f of ['kpis','key_drivers','confirmed_findings','ruled_out_or_weak_drivers','remaining_uncertainties','recommended_actions','visualizations','evidence'])if(!Array.isArray(result[f]))throw new Error(f+' must be an array');if(!['high','medium','low'].includes(result.confidence))throw new Error('Invalid confidence');result.meta={generated_at:new Date().toISOString(),backend:'n8n',storage:'supabase-postgresql-jsonb',contract_version:'2.0'};return [{json:result}];

const req=$('Normalize Analysis Request').first().json,result=$json;function q(v){if(v===null||v===undefined)return 'NULL';return `'${String(v).replace(/'/g,"''")}'`;}const sql=`INSERT INTO public.dealos_investigations (dataset_id,organization_id,user_id,session_id,original_question,result_json,confidence) VALUES (${q(req.dataset_id)}::uuid,${q(req.organization_id)},${q(req.user_id)},${q(req.session_id)},${q(req.question)},${q(JSON.stringify(result))}::jsonb,${q(result.confidence)});`;return [{json:{...result,_save_sql:sql}}];

parameters.query:
SELECT row_number, clean_data
FROM public.dealos_dataset_rows
WHERE dataset_id = $1::uuid
ORDER BY row_number
LIMIT $2::int;

SELECT
  d.id::text AS dataset_id,
  d.name,
  d.original_filename,
  d.row_count_raw,
  d.row_count_clean,
  d.column_count,
  d.quality_score,
  d.domain,
  d.grain_description,
  d.grain_confidence,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'column_name', c.column_name,
        'original_name', c.original_name,
        'detected_type', c.detected_type,
        'semantic_role', c.semantic_role,
        'business_meaning', c.business_meaning,
        'null_pct', c.null_pct,
        'unique_count', c.unique_count,
        'sample_values', c.sample_values
      ) ORDER BY c.column_name
    )
    FROM public.dealos_dataset_columns c
    WHERE c.dataset_id = d.id
  ), '[]'::jsonb) AS columns,
  COALESCE((
    SELECT jsonb_agg(
      jsonb_build_object(
        'name', m.name,
        'label', m.label,
        'description', m.description,
        'aggregation', m.aggregation,
        'expression', m.expression,
        'confidence', m.confidence
      ) ORDER BY m.name
    )
    FROM public.dealos_dataset_metrics m
    WHERE m.dataset_id = d.id
  ), '[]'::jsonb) AS metrics
FROM public.dealos_datasets d
WHERE d.id = $1::uuid
LIMIT 1;
